title: Book Two · Chapter 36: Two Sharp Pencils
story:
Dad carries the old box back to work on Monday.

The drawer is inside it. A strip of paper protects the brass handle. Ronan watches him tie the cloth.

“Is it ready?”

“No. I checked the sides. Now I need to work on the drawer.”

“Will the woman come today?”

“No. Not this Saturday. The Saturday after that. Mr Sun has her work card.”

Dad lifts the box. Ronan takes his school bag, and they leave together. At the corner, Dad turns towards the main road. Ronan walks on to school.

Leo is already at the desk. He has two pencils in front of him. One has a new yellow end.

“For tomorrow?” Ronan asks.

“I will use one. The other is extra. A point can break.”

Ronan puts his own pencil beside them. It is shorter, but its point is sharp.

“Yours will finish first,” Leo says.

“The pencil?”

“It has less wood to carry.”

Jun sits down behind them and shakes his head.

Miss Wu begins the morning lesson. They work with numbers first. Later she gives them a short page about a lost hat.

“Not tomorrow's story,” she says. “We can talk about this one together.”

Ronan reads it once. A girl finds a hat near a tree. She carries it to the gate. An old man comes back for it.

He puts his hand up for the first question.

“The old man owns the hat.”

“Show me the line,” Miss Wu says.

Ronan finds it. The answer is there. He feels pleased and lets his hand rest on the desk.

The next question is for Mei. She points to another line. Her answer is different from Leo's. They look at it together, then Leo changes his answer.

At break, he puts the yellow pencil back in its cloth case.

“I read too fast.”

“Mei read it once,” Ronan says.

“She saw that line.”

Leo goes outside with Jun. Ronan looks at the page again. He can find both answers now. Tomorrow he must read alone. Nobody will point out the answers for him.

After school, he brings his two pencils to Mum. She checks the points and gives them back.

“They are both ready.”

“Should I take a third?”

“Do you want to carry the whole shelf?”

He grins and puts the two away.

Mum needs the table for a customer's coat. Ronan moves to his bed. He reads one old page. Then he closes the book. He wants to rest his eyes for a while.

Dad comes home later. The wooden box is not with him. It is on the work shelf at Mr Sun's.

“Any more questions tonight?” Dad asks.

“No. I know the hat story.”

“Then you can stop for tonight.”

Ronan goes to the kitchen for water. His school bag stands by the door. He checks the small pocket once, feels both pencils, and leaves them there.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

protect＝保护；point＝笔尖；own＝属于、拥有；case＝盒、套。

## 理解问题

1. 父亲周一为什么要把木盒带回柜台？
2. Ronan为周二做了哪些准备？

## 读句子

Its point / is sharp.＝它的笔尖／很尖。
